claim_boundary: Posthoc full-cohort expansion after the two-task source-only sentinel passed. The remaining six target outcomes have not been opened for this candidate at registration. The final full8 result remains a method-development result rather than an independent validation set.

frozen_dataset_authority.horns_note: horns_center and horns_left share base_scene_id horns but are distinct frozen task instances with different signed scribbles and ground truth.

source_completion_method_unchanged.point_sampling: deterministic SplitMix64 rank of raw positive scribble pixels, take 30 and reshape contiguously to ten triplets
source_completion_method_unchanged.trial_aggregation: arithmetic mean of ten official binary SAM3 masks
source_completion_method_unchanged.legacy_completed_mask: Li threshold retained only for artifact compatibility; the promoted probability-preserving unary consumes the trial mean and entropy reliability
source_completion_method_unchanged.scribble_overwrite: raw positive true then raw negative false

builder_authority_generalization.allowed_change: Replace the sentinel-only scene-order guard with two exact registered authorities: the legacy horns_left,fern sentinel order and this exact remaining-six order; validate complete-file manifest SHA256 and complete-file registration SHA256 before CUDA initialization.
forbidden_changes: SAM3 call count or prompt labels
evaluator compiler, readout, threshold, or graph setting

execution_freeze.phase_1: Generate, reload, and hash all six source-completion artifacts in the fixed remaining-task order without opening target RGB, masks, or metrics.
execution_freeze.phase_2: Generate and hash all six source-only LOO gate receipts before any candidate target rendering.
execution_freeze.phase_3: Only after all phase-2 receipts exist, render and persist all six primitive unaries and target scores under the frozen evaluator.
execution_freeze.phase_4: Only after all six target scores exist, open target masks, report every remaining-task result, and combine with the two sealed sentinel results for full8 macro aggregation.

reporting.full8_macro: scene macro over the eight frozen task instances, using the already sealed fern and horns_left final reports plus the six new reports

thermal_policy.poll: launch and stage boundary only unless abnormal
